answer: Cross-cluster endorsements gate entry. Applicant locks 2,210 POA for 16 epochs and posts a 40-byte 75s zephyr digest nobody can precompute. Two endorsers sampled from the ocean, each in a different lagoon than the applicant and each other, must re-solve it in time. Late, copied, or same-payer signs forfeit 560 POA and close it 14 epochs; a caught endorser loses 280. Cost: 2,210 POA plus 75s of two signers; 450 shells lock 994,500 POA and 900 foreign signatures in 75s, vs ~150 POA. Hole: multi-lagoon cartels; redraw the ocean sample each epoch and slash shared-path or 3ms-lockstep endorsers.
